subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) A wide range of (i) has a television set. programmes of varied interest (b) Television (ii) is telecast on numerus programmes channels. (c) Television has become (iii) are both entertaining and educative (d) Watching TV (iv) the most common and widespread source of entertainment of the present world (e) Almost every middle (v) are looked down upon class and even working class family (vi) has become an addiction for many (vii) have watched it
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (ii) A wide range of programmes of varied interest is telecast on numerous channels. (b) + (iii) Television programmes are both entertaining and educative. (c) + (iv) Television has become the most common and widespread source of entertainment of the present world. (d) + (vi) Watching TV has become an addiction for many. (e) + (i) Almost every middle class and even working class family has a television set.
